'''Players Committee rule changes''' are rules changes and rulings announced by the [[Players Committee]] (PC). Each entry below gives the dated decision and a before/after comparison. For constructed pools see [[Formats]]; for rules documents by era see [[Rulebooks]].

|}

== Personas rule changes (November 2021) ==

=== Source and dates ===

The Players Committee posted '''Significant Rule Changes on Personas Announced''' on '''6 November 2021'''. The updates apply to all official Players Committee sanctioned events and all GEMP formats from '''9 November 2021'''.<ref name="personas2021">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/significant-rule-changes-on-personas-announced/ Significant Rule Changes on Personas Announced], starwarsccg.org (6 November 2021). Preserved copy: [http://web.archive.org/web/20211111224905id_/https://www.starwarsccg.org/significant-rule-changes-on-personas-announced/ Internet Archive] (11 November 2021)</ref>

=== Decision ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Content (from PC announce)
|-
| '''Problem / design goal''' || Open design space for characters who work on either side of the Force; update related persona / uniqueness / out-of-play handling; unify Sidious naming.<ref name="personas2021" />
|-
| '''Dated decision''' || Announced '''6 November 2021'''; tournament/GEMP effective '''9 November 2021'''.<ref name="personas2021" />
|-
| '''Where incorporated''' || The announce directs readers to the guide and forum Q&amp;A. Current comprehensive rules are in the [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]].
|}

=== Before / after (six numbered changes) ===

The six changes follow the announce's numbered headings. '''Before''' gives the prior practice the announce changes; '''After''' paraphrases the announce.<ref name="personas2021" />

==== 1. Two Landos (and other personas!) ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Before (prior uniqueness / persona practice the announce changes)
! After (PC announce, effective 9 November 2021)
|-
| style="vertical-align:top; max-width:28em" | Same persona could not usefully exist as opposing Light and Dark versions on table at once under the old persona blocking practice the announce replaces.
| style="vertical-align:top; max-width:28em" | '''It is now possible for the same persona to exist on both sides of the Force at the same time.''' The announce cites a forthcoming Dark Side Lando in Set 17 usable even if a Light Side Lando is already on table.<ref name="personas2021" />
|}

==== 2. Uniqueness rules still apply ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Before
! After
|-
| style="vertical-align:top" | Unique cards with the '''exact same card title''' could not share the table.
| style="vertical-align:top" | '''Uniqueness still applies:''' if two unique cards (example given: Light Lobot and Dark Lobot) have the exact same card title, they still are not allowed on table at the same time. Conversion example: if Tonnika Sisters convert to Light, Dark could not play another Tonnika Sisters.<ref name="personas2021" />
|}

==== 3. Capturing and stealing ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Before
! After
|-
| style="vertical-align:top" | Capturing / stealing denied the opponent use of those cards.
| style="vertical-align:top" | '''Kept:''' any persona who is a captive on table prevents Light from deploying that persona; any stolen card on table prevents the other player from deploying that persona.<ref name="personas2021" />
|}

==== 4. Out of play ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Before
! After
|-
| style="vertical-align:top" | Out-of-play handling was not described in this announce's &quot;each player&quot; form.
| style="vertical-align:top" | '''Each player has their own out-of-play (OOP) area.''' If your Lando goes OOP, you (not your opponent) are prevented from deploying Lando again that game. If you steal Falcon and it goes OOP onto your OOP area, you (not your opponent) are prevented from deploying Falcon again that game.<ref name="personas2021" />
|}

==== 5. Mind Tricks Don't Work On Me ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Before
! After
|-
| style="vertical-align:top" | (Announce addresses edge cases of multiple copies of one persona on one side.)
| style="vertical-align:top" | '''Each player is allowed ONE of each persona on table.''' If a convoluted legal plan would put two Falcons on the same side at once, the rules will require placing one in your Lost Pile (it is not &quot;just lost&quot;). Illegal plays remain a TD matter.<ref name="personas2021" />
|}

==== 6. Sidious, Palpatine and Emperor ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Before (announce's stated prior practice)
! After (PC announce)
|-
| style="vertical-align:top; max-width:28em" | Palpatine / Sidious / Emperor had long been treated as separated for gameplay; the FAQ notes this stood for over 20 years in large part because Light Palpatine needed to stay separate from Dark's Dark Jedi Master.<ref name="personas2021" />
| style="vertical-align:top; max-width:28em" | Unified as one persona, '''&quot;Sidious&quot;'''. Each player may have one Sidious persona card on table at a time. Card references: &quot;Sidious&quot; &rarr; any of his cards (announce lists Senator Palpatine, Darth Sidious, Lord Sidious, Emperor Palpatine, The Emperor, Emperor Palpatine Foreseer, Palpatine Emperor Returned); &quot;Palpatine&quot; &rarr; Sidious versions with Palpatine in the title; &quot;Emperor&quot; &rarr; Sidious versions with Emperor in the title.<ref name="personas2021" />
|}

=== Examples (from the announce) ===

The announce includes worked examples (Lando uniqueness vs conversion, stolen Millennium Falcon, Sidious deploy discounts, Force Lightning requiring &quot;Emperor&quot; in title).<ref name="personas2021" />

== Announcements of 2006–2008 ==

* '''18 May 2006:''' the Players Committee posted '''Current Rulings and Erratas (1/2005 – 5/2006)''', a thread of the official rulings and errata issued by the Rules Committee, and recommended that all players check it for updates before going to any tournament.<ref name="pc-news2006">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&new_topic News], swccgpc.com (18 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060617220030/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&new_topic Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''June 2006:''' players on the Players Committee forum discussed changes in the revised virtual cards: the starting [[Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Set 8)|Careful Planning (V)]] and [[Combat Readiness (V) (Virtual Set 8)|Combat Readiness (V)]] setups no longer had the option of a fourth Effect,<ref name="pcf-10278-140809">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=140809#140809 New CP/CR(v) Starts], Indiana Jones Jedi Knight, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (12 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618093800/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=10278&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref> and [[Lee Clarke]] wrote that [[Superficial Damage (V) (Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon)|Superficial Damage (V)]] and another card (which he called "Incon Losses V") had previously allowed mines that blew up to go to the Used Pile instead of the Lost Pile.<ref name="pcf-10279-140889">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=140889#140889 June 2006 virtual card revisions thread], Lee Clarke (LCJK), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (13 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618094303/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=10279&view=previous Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''20 December 2007:''' the Committee posted '''Rules Changes – Characteristics'''. Several months earlier the player community had voiced concerns over characteristics, which began as remarks about a few cards and led to questions about the card identification system itself.<ref name="pc-topic7">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&new_topic=7 Rules Committee (news topic)], swccgpc.com (20 December 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080915153935/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&new_topic=7 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''17 April 2008:''' the rules about the start of the game were clarified: players do not use, lose or activate Force during the start of the game. The Committee said the clarification answered a growing number of start-of-game issues, such as what would happen if a site were deployed to [[Ralltiir]] during the start of the game while [[Insignificant Rebellion (V)]] was on table.<ref name="pc-sid84">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=84 Errata to [v11] Restricted Access], swccgpc.com (17 April 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080712072016/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=84 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''15 August 2008:''' rules notes for [[Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith|Virtual Set 16]] reminded players that whatever a v-slip covers is superseded by the slip, and that the white text in the bottom border of a virtual card only identifies the physical card to use and has no effect on gameplay. They also said that "Clone" is not a characteristic (so it can appear only in title, game text or subtype, not lore), that Palpatine (Light Side), Sidious and the Emperor are three different characters for game play, and that a character without politics may have politics added (treated as starting at 0), a card with 0 politics being a card without politics.<ref name="pc-sid95">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=95 Rules Info For Virtual Set 16], swccgpc.com (15 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080906211146/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=95 Internet Archive]</ref>
